Job Title: Platform & Tools Developer
 Location: Bucharest, Romania
 Type: Permanent
 Our client are a Physical AI company looking for Engineers to work on-site in Bucharest.
 Key Responsibilities
 Architect, deploy, and operate AWS-based data pipelines to collect and structure hardware test data.
 Build and scale backend services, including database-backed GraphQL APIs and S3 storage solutions.
 Develop, maintain, and document a stable internal SDK utilized by other engineering teams.
 Create intuitive visualization and analytics tools to make production and test data easily explorable.
 Own system lifecycles end-to-end, encompassing architecture, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring, and triage.
 Partner directly with hardware, firmware, and manufacturing engineers to translate ambiguous requirements into reliable tooling.
 Requirements:
 Professional-level Python programming with a focus on clean interfaces and maintainable code.
 Comfort reading and writing C or C++ for lower-level SDK development.
 Strong system design fundamentals (data modeling, API contracts, scalability, failure modes).
 Hands-on experience building backend services and APIs (REST or GraphQL) backed by real databases.
 Working DevOps knowledge (CI/CD, containerization, Infrastructure-as-Code, logging/monitoring).
 A track record of shipping highly adopted internal tools across a broad stack (backend, data pipelines, lightweight frontend).
 Desirables:
 Hands-on AWS expertise (Lambda, S3, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, IAM).
 Infrastructure-as-Code experience (Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK).
 Advanced GraphQL experience (schema design, resolvers, federation).
 Containerized deployment experience using Docker, Kubernetes, or ECS.
 Experience with dashboarding frameworks like Streamlit, Dash, or Grafana.
 If this sounds of interest, please reach out to daniel@microtech-global.com for more information
